name: snapshots remain isolated from later mutations
input: add, snapshot, mutate, and read both versions
test:
items = SnapshotSet()
assert items.snapshot() == 0
assert items.add('a') is True
first = items.snapshot()
assert items.add('b') is True
assert items.remove('a') is True
latest = items.snapshot()
assert items.values_at(first) == {'a'}
assert items.values_at(latest) == {'b'}
copy = items.values_at(first); copy.add('mutated')
assert items.values_at(first) == {'a'}

name: no-op mutations still preserve a distinct current version
